title: Dealer Participation and Quarterly Volume Bonus: Dealer Support Training Note
content:
Dealer Retail Agreements pay two kinds of dealer compensation: contract participation of the flat participation figure for the dealer's tier on the funding date, paid with the initial funding of the contract, and a quarterly volume bonus paid after each quarterly tier review.

## The terms

1. Contract participation of the flat participation figure for the dealer's tier on the funding date is paid with the initial funding of the contract.
2. After each quarterly tier review a volume bonus of the per-contract volume bonus figure of the reviewed tier for every contract funded in the quarter is paid within 15 calendar days after the quarter's tier review; a suspended or terminated dealer earns no bonus for that quarter.

## Figures by tier

| Dealer Program tier | Flat participation per purchased contract (USD) | Quarterly volume bonus per contract funded in the quarter (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Dealer Program Bronze | 150.00 | 0.00 (none) |
| Dealer Program Silver | 200.00 | 0.00 (none) |
| Dealer Program Gold | 250.00 | 25.00 |
| Dealer Program Platinum | 300.00 | 50.00 |
| Dealer Program Diamond | 350.00 | 75.00 |
| Dealer Program Elite | 400.00 | 100.00 |

A volume bonus figure of 0.00 means none. For every tier the bonus is paid within 15 calendar days after the quarter's tier review, and participation is paid with the initial funding of the contract.

## Questions answered

**Which tier sets the participation on a contract?** The dealer's tier on the funding date of that contract.

**When is participation paid?** With the initial funding of the contract — one participation payment per purchased contract, recorded on the payment date with the amount paid.

**Which tier sets the volume bonus?** The reviewed tier of the quarter's tier review, applied to every contract funded in the quarter.

**What does a suspended or terminated dealer earn as volume bonus?** No bonus for that quarter.

**How do these payments move the agreement's balance?** The agreement's net participation balance increases when participation or a bonus is paid, and decreases when participation is charged back.

## Hypothetical illustration

A dealer (hypothetical) funded 40 contracts in a quarter, and the quarter's tier review set its tier at Dealer Program Platinum. The volume bonus is 40 times 50.00, which is 2,000.00, paid within 15 calendar days after that review. Had the same review set the tier at Dealer Program Silver, the bonus figure would be 0.00 and no bonus would be paid. Had the dealer been suspended for that quarter, it would earn no bonus for the quarter.
